verdict.rationale: Sprinto's API reference has a dedicated "Custom Integration Push APIs" section that includes integration monitoring. Its ingestion docs describe webhooks with unique endpoint URLs that let external systems send data directly into Sprinto, trigger ingestion workflows, and troubleshoot failed requests, which covers pushing data from uncatalogued systems. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint and payload documentation for the push APIs (only page titles are evidenced, and no OpenAPI spec was found at probed paths), explicit confirmation that pushed data maps to evidence/test results on controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
